## Electrical Engineer & Researcher

**Power Systems · Data Center Energy · Microgrids · Photovoltaics**

I am a Ph.D. Candidate in Electrical and Computer Engineering at the
University of Delaware. My work spans power systems, renewable energy,
data-center energy systems, microgrids, photovoltaics, energy storage,
load forecasting, and data-driven energy analysis.

My research focuses on understanding how **emerging electric loads,
distributed energy resources, renewable generation, and energy storage**
can be integrated into reliable, resilient, and economically viable
power systems.

---

## Current Research

### Data Center Energy Systems

Grid impacts, load forecasting, emerging load behavior, resource
planning, and energy infrastructure for large computing facilities.

[Learn more →](research.qmd#data-center-energy-systems)

### Microgrids & Energy Storage

Renewable and resilient microgrids, PV+BESS integration,
techno-economic analysis, grid interaction, and islanded operation.

[Learn more →](research.qmd#microgrids--energy-storage)

### Photovoltaic Systems

Bifacial PV, irradiance characterization, performance monitoring,
energy prediction, and photovoltaic system modeling.

[Learn more →](research.qmd#photovoltaic-systems)

### Power Systems & Energy Analytics

Load modeling, renewable integration, distributed energy resources,
forecasting, physics-informed modeling, and machine learning for
energy systems.

[Learn more →](research.qmd#data-analytics-for-energy-systems)
